scene: An airy glass conservatory with pale marble flooring and magenta psychic light.

casual_plan.scene: At a dark tiled moonlit pool edge with violet underwater lights, her hands rest on the rim behind her.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque white high-neck racerback one-piece athletic swimsuit with broad green side panels and a small crimson gem clasp at the collar; no cover-up.

axis_reasons.action_level: Resting against the pool rim is a still recovery pose.
axis_reasons.source_influence: Green panel lines and crimson clasp visibly echo Kirlia.
axis_reasons.separates_preference: The monokini is a single connected garment.

casual_plan.scene: Inside a rehearsal studio at sunrise, she transitions across a wooden floor between two plain practice floor markers; no mirrors or writing.
casual_plan.outfit: Ivory scoop-neck short-sleeve dance wrap top ending at the waist, separate green chiffon knee-length wrap skirt over crimson fitted dance shorts and soft pale ballet shoes; tiny red stud earrings.

axis_reasons.action_level: A transition dance step is active weight transfer.
axis_reasons.source_influence: A green wrap skirt and red studs retain recognizable colors in ordinary dancewear.
axis_reasons.separates_preference: Wrap top, skirt and dance shorts are separate pieces.

axis_reasons.action_level: A sleeve is being pulled from the browsing bin.
axis_reasons.source_influence: Green-red-white clothing preserves palette without a large costume emblem.
axis_reasons.separates_preference: Sweater, trousers and open vest produce visible separated layers.

faceEvidence.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 턱선 · 턱끝 부드럽고 둥근 턱 → 각지고 또렷한 턱

planning_decision: Each cut uses a different category, activity, silhouette, expression, pose, orientation and framing. Direction/frame pairs differ from comparison cuts; at least one direction is new. Source influence multiset differs from comparison characters.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, medium width; angular defined jaw; almond eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; long arched brows; small delicate nose; bow-shaped upper lip.
faceComparison: Actual whole-image comparison of recent Taillow, Swellow, Wingull, Pelipper and Ralts: Kirlia has a broader defined jaw, level almond eyes, long arched brows and bow-shaped upper lip; Ralts retains narrow tapered chin and downturned eyes. Shoulder-length wavy hair and tall lean build remain fixed in all nine.

revisions.reason: Image-generation safety system rejected initial output.
revisions.changed: Replaced monokini outfit with opaque white high-neck racerback athletic one-piece; retained moonlit_pool example and scene, poses, axes, locks and framing.
